function: Vision-aided THz channel estimation: MulT extracts environment features from RGB-D images, causal VCD/VAE estimates path gain, AoA/AoD and distance, then reconstructs the channel matrix (pp. 5-10).
system: Downlink V2I, BS with Nt-element ULA and users with Nr-element ULA (counts not given), no RIS, 0.1 THz carrier, 240 subcarriers (pp. 3, 11).
method: MulT (Swin transformer) extracts features from RGB-D images; variational causal dynamics with VAE decoder estimates channel variables; trained with MSE and ELBO, sparse-mechanism-shift adaptation (pp. 5-11).
data_channel: Custom CARLA urban scenes with MATLAB ray tracing at 0.1 THz (five paths, one reflection); ray-traced variables are ground truth; no public or measured data (p. 11).
test_conditions: Trained on scenario 1; tested on scenario 1, scenario 2 (different users and speeds), unseen scenarios 3 and 4; SNR 5-35 dB, 1-5 paths, 10-50 km/h (pp. 12-14).
baselines: Non-learned: matrix completion (nuclear norm). Learned: CNN, LSTM, MAE with 24 or 32 pilots [47], multi-task + GNN (p. 12).
metrics: MSE of the estimated channel response versus SNR (5-35 dB), number of paths and vehicle speed; percent MSE improvement and degradation (pp. 10, 12-14).
complexity: Order stated for the VCD head, O(Ec d); the MulT encoder is described as transformer-like scaling with reduced tokens; no FLOPs, parameters or measured runtime (p. 11).
openness: none; no code or data link, data generated with CARLA and MATLAB ray tracing (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 11: "The channel variables extracted from this CARLA-based raytracing setup are used as ground truth in our experiments." Custom CARLA and MATLAB ray-tracing setup with a Saleh-Valenzuela model (p. 3); 3GPP TR 38.901, IEEE 802.15.3d and NYUSIM are only named as models the approach could use (p. 4), not used in the experiments.
q2_support: p. 12: "A completely unseen environment for both" the baselines and the proposed model (scenarios 3 and 4); p. 13: "are trained on data from scenario 1", with scenarios 2 to 4 used for testing.
q3_support: p. 12: "Matrix Completion (MC): A classical pilot-only baseline" is the non-learned one; "CNN-based Channel Estimator, 32 Pilots", LSTM, MAE [47] and multi-task + GNN are learned; all compared on MSE in Figs. 5 and 6 (pp. 13-14).
q4_support: p. 11: "the VCD head adds only O(Ec d)" in the Complexity Analysis, with the MulT encoder following "transformer-like scaling"; only orders are given, no FLOPs, parameter count or measured runtime, so borderline.
q5_support: p. 11: "Carla [36] 3D simulation data" and MATLAB ray tracing generate the data; no code or data link or DOI is given, and no public or measured channel dataset is used.
notes: RIS appears only as a motivating application (pp. 17-18); the system has no RIS. Antenna counts are not stated numerically. q4 is borderline: the proposed method gets an explicit order only for the VCD head plus a qualitative statement for the encoder, and inference time in milliseconds is cited from [43], not measured. Reviewer to confirm.
